capabilities: plan trips day by day in a single note with reorderable steps
track bookings and documents with their location and owner
manage a packing list and to-dos with automatic reminders
sum up trip costs against a budget in the trip's currency
create typed place notes for restaurants, museums and venues
extras: Free, with an optional Ko-fi donation. Part of a 'Cool plugins' family sharing a Cool Bar. Some documentation (properties list) is only in Spanish. Notes about Obsidian Sync's per-file size limit when storing documents in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to plan a trip in a single note with an itinerary, bookings, documents, packing and budget in one place.

relations.evidence: With Cool Bases they show up as boarding passes and a city guide.
It sends the place's name and city to OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) and nothing else.

summary: Trip planner that builds each trip as one Markdown note with a boarding-pass cover, a day-by-day itinerary, bookings, packing lists and costs.
